newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Mobile started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Mobile started.

text.p: -- Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc said Friday it initiated coverage of American Mobile Satellite Corp with a rating of market performer.

-- American Mobile is the only mobile satellite communications company covering the entire United States and it is targeting such niche markets as transportation, aeronautical and maritime, Rauscher Pierce said.
-- Those niche markets are less sensitive to the size of the communications terminal and more sensitive to the cost of the service, Rauscher Pierce said.
-- American Mobile provides mobile satellite communications seervices.
-- Its shares closed unchanged Friday at 10-3/4.
